name: Biped
description: Two-legged mech. Never statically stable: it stands on one foot for most of the cycle, so it needs a big Gyro Stabilizer. A stress test for the stabilizer model.

proposal.summary: Iconic but demanding: shows how much a Gyro Stabilizer has to cover when the walker is never statically stable.
decisions: Gyro Stabilizer rated 120 mass·b for a 58-mass walker: it needs 107 mass·b (centre of mass 1.84 b from the single planted foot), about 1.8× its own mass, against 1.1× for the Quad Strider.
No foothold search: shows raw foot placement on stairs and trenches.
openQuestions: Should bipeds be allowed at all, or only with a stabilizer this large?
With 0 feet planted (trench) no stabilizer can help: should the mod refuse such steps?
